name: Merge Intervals
description: Given a list of intervals, merge all overlapping ones. Sort by start time, then greedily merge intervals that overlap.
aim: Reduce overlapping intervals to non-overlapping merged intervals: sort by start, merge if current start ≤ last merged end.
howItWorks: Take first interval as current merged
If it overlaps (start ≤ last end): extend end = max(last end, current end)
Else: push merged interval, start new merge

complexity.spaceDescription: Output can be up to n non-overlapping intervals

realWorld: Database range queries — combine overlapping conditions
whenToUse: Finding total coverage of time intervals
alternatives: Sweep line — handles more complex interval problems
Interval tree — for fast overlap queries on large sets

inputHint: Pairs of numbers, each pair one interval as (start, end).
